# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Local Administrators

Determines who is a member of the local Administrators group, so that LAPS manages a controlled group instead of whatever happens to be on the device.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog (endpointSecurityAccountProtection) |
| Assignment | All Devices |
| Source | OpenIntuneBaseline Windows v4.0 — ES - Local Group Membership - D - Local Administrators |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Local_Administrators.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Local_Administrators.json) |

> LAPS without a managed administrators group is half the job: LAPS rotates the password of an account that nobody else manages.

## Standards

| Framework | Controls |
|---|---|

| NIS2 art. 21(2) | art. 21(2)(i) human resources security, access control policies and asset management |
| CIS Controls v8.1 | 5.4 Restrict Administrator Privileges to Dedicated Administrator Accounts |
| NIST CSF 2.0 | PR.AA-05 |

What this means per standard and what is needed organisationally alongside it: [COMPLIANCE.en.md](../../../COMPLIANCE.en.md).
